checks.result: Read remotely at the pinned base revision. State claims were treated as reported context, not verified execution.

Source review: lens finite/range validation and minimum 0.05 m distance guard precede construction. EmitterFrame independently rejects invalid camera/subject positions and zero direction. Position.isValid limits each finite coordinate to [-100,100].

checks.check: Vertical view fallback and basis convention
checks.result: Source review: EmitterFrame uses horizontal hypot and a deterministic +X emitter-right fallback when horizontal <= 1e-12; camera right is its negative. Cross-product up remains nonzero at straight-up/down views. The near-vertical fallback can introduce at most threshold-sized non-orthogonality; no material projection defect established.

Source review: position differences and dot products remain Double, valid coordinate differences are bounded to 200 m per axis, and scale-normalized UnitDirection avoids normalization overflow/underflow. No Float narrowing or unbounded arithmetic is present in the reviewed camera projection path.

checks.check: Focal field of view and coverage
checks.result: Source review: horizontal and vertical FOV use 2*atan(sensorDimension/(2*focalLength)); plane coverage uses distance*sensorDimension/focalLength, consistent with a 36x24 mm ideal sensor and 14...200 mm lens domain.
